newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil recovers, diesel premium extends rally.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil recovers, diesel premium extends rally.

text.p: NWE gas oil prices recovered on Friday in line with IPE futures, correcting Thursday's heavy losses, and diesel premiums rose sharply again on a continuing perception of scarcity, traders said.
IPE November gas oil futures rose $1.75 to $226.25 per tonne ahead of expected cooler weather in the Northeast U.S. this weekend and perceptions of tight inventories.

Traders differed over the fundamental supply picture for European heating oil, but the company which took 100,000 tonnes out of the October IPE expiry said it was all pre-sold and unlikely to impose any pressure on barge premiums.
"We are well away from having a comfortable supply situation," a German trader said, attributing Thursday's massive sell-off to profit-taking by investment funds.

Heating oil premiums were stable in Rotterdam, with prompt barges offered at Nov IPE +$7-8 fob, but diesel remained in very short supply, and German winter grade barges were offered at Nov IPE +$36.00 fob ARA, $5 above Thursday's notional premium.
Cargo demand was strong in Germany and France. One cargo was talked around Nov IPE +$34 cif southern France, dealers said.
